description: This file defines the MetadataStrategyInterface interface within the Aws\Crypto namespace, specifying methods for saving and loading metadata envelopes related to encryption strategies in AWS SDK.

classes.name: MetadataStrategyInterface
classes.description: An interface that outlines methods for saving and loading metadata envelopes according to specific encryption strategies.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Defines how to store encryption metadata in a MetadataEnvelope and populate the arguments for the PutObject operation.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Defines how to generate a MetadataEnvelope from provided arguments, typically containing S3 object information and related headers.
